_metadata.description: Secrets Manager operational requirements aligned with the minimal PRD (v2.0)

requirements.title: Trusted receipt signing status
requirements.description: When an operator requests receipt-signing status, Secrets Manager shall report signer health and key identity without returning signing key material, Vault tokens, or credential paths.

requirements.title: Repository secret manifest discovery
requirements.description: Enumerate every config/secrets manifest across scenarios/resources and normalize keys + metadata for downstream validation.

requirements.title: Persist secret requirements in Postgres
requirements.description: Create and maintain the resource_secrets / secret_validations tables plus seeding scripts that describe each required secret.

requirements.title: Vault CLI integration with graceful fallback
requirements.description: Drive `resource-vault secrets validate/check` for canonical status and fall back to local parsing when CLI output is unavailable.

requirements.title: Vault health endpoint
requirements.description: Expose `/api/v1/vault/secrets/status` with totals, missing secrets, timestamps, and per-resource health that other surfaces can consume.

requirements.title: Resource secrets workspace
requirements.description: Provide per-resource views with secret lists, owners, rotation notes, and inline actions to sync or open provisioning flows.

requirements.title: Cross-scenario code scanning
requirements.description: Scan Go/TypeScript files for hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, and http misuse with component metadata for each finding.

requirements.title: Risk scoring and severity weighting
requirements.description: Calculate overall risk and per-vulnerability severity counts so compliance consumers see the weighted exposure.

requirements.title: Remediation intelligence
requirements.description: Attach remediation steps, ownership hints, and jump-to-code links for every vulnerability so operators know the next best action.

requirements.title: Unified compliance aggregator
requirements.description: Blend vault coverage, vulnerability stats, and risk scores into `/security/compliance` for dashboard + CLI consumption.

requirements.title: Lifecycle health instrumentation
requirements.description: Expose `/health` plus lifecycle metadata so the orchestrator can monitor API/UI availability and restart as needed.

requirements.title: Tier strategy metadata
requirements.description: Store per-tier handling strategies (strip/generate/prompt/delegate) for every secret and surface them via API + CLI.

requirements.title: Bundle manifest export
requirements.description: Generate machine-readable bundles describing selected secrets, tiers, prompts, and generators for deployment-manager and scenario-to-*.

requirements.title: Deployment-manager handshake
requirements.description: Expose `/deployment/secrets` + webhook push so deployment-manager can visualize plans, request updates, and confirm readiness.

requirements.title: Scenario-to-* integration
requirements.description: Provide SDK/CLI helpers so scenario-to-desktop/mobile/cloud can request tier manifests and receive scoped secrets during packaging.

requirements.title: Guided provisioning API
requirements.description: Enable `/vault/secrets/provision` (and CLI helper) to accept secret payloads, write to Vault, and trigger validation refreshes.

requirements.title: CLI status proxy
requirements.description: `secrets-manager status` should call `/health`, respect env/config overrides, and emit JSON for automation.

requirements.title: CLI wrappers for vault/compliance/vulnerabilities
requirements.description: Expose thin commands that forward filters to the API instead of re-implementing parsing or data munging locally.

requirements.title: Dashboard hero metrics
requirements.description: Show top-line counts (configured resources, risk score, missing secrets) sourced directly from compliance + vault endpoints.

requirements.title: Vault coverage module
requirements.description: Display per-resource coverage bars, severity badges, and missing secret callouts with automatic refresh via React Query.

requirements.title: Vulnerability filter panel
requirements.description: Allow filtering by severity, component, or type with responsive tables that mirror the `/vulnerabilities` API params.

requirements.title: Compliance callout
requirements.description: Highlight the blended risk score with textual guidance plus iconography that reflects severity thresholds.

requirements.title: Accessible dark-chrome theme
requirements.description: Apply consistent typography, contrast, and motion guidelines so the cyberpunk aesthetic still passes WCAG AA.

requirements.title: Orientation landing hub
requirements.description: Design the home view with hero stats, deployment readiness tiles, and journey cards (configure secrets, fix vulns, prep deployments).

requirements.title: Guided remedial flows
requirements.description: Provide multi-step wizards for each journey so operators move from detection to resolution with progress indicators and contextual help.

requirements.title: Contextual action rail
requirements.description: Every table/detail panel should surface the next action (open provisioning, file issue, run scan) with inline status + blockers.

requirements.title: Historical validation telemetry
requirements.description: Track secret validation runs + scan events over time to power compliance deltas and future analytics.

requirements.title: File content gateway
requirements.description: Provide a secure `/files/content` endpoint for reviewing snippets referenced by vulnerabilities with path safeguards.

requirements.title: Schema + seed automation
requirements.description: Lifecycle `setup` must run schema + seed SQL files and remain idempotent so agents can reset environments quickly.

requirements.title: Phased testing alignment
requirements.description: `test/run-tests.sh` must execute structure/unit/integration/performance phases and emit artifacts referencing `[REQ:ID]` tags.

requirements.title: Auto-remediation suggestions
requirements.description: Surface remediation text or trigger claude-code agents that can automatically patch common vulnerability classes.

requirements.title: Trend analytics
requirements.description: Compute and display rolling averages plus anomaly detection for risk scores and vault coverage deltas.

requirements.title: Policy gating hooks
requirements.description: Expose an API/CLI to block deployments or scenario actions until secrets + security thresholds are satisfied.

requirements.title: CI-friendly export
requirements.description: Provide a CLI/API command that exports validated secrets and vulnerability summaries for CI pipelines without manual parsing.
